study: X.-W. Zhang, C. Wang, X. Liu, Y. Fan, T. Cao, D. Xiao, Polarization-driven band topology evolution in twisted MoTe2 and WSe2, Nat. Commun. 15, 4223 (2024); data: Zenodo 10888769 (CC BY 4.0)

staged_files.archive/fig1/set_P, archive/fig1/set_Q: the two continuum-model parameter maps of the paper's Fig. 1 (one from the local-stacking approximation, one fitted to a 3.89 deg tMoTe2 DFT calculation; the labels P and Q are arbitrary): Delta-bot.dat, Delta-top.dat (columns Re, Im, |.| in meV, 100 x 100 grid) and Delta-T.dat (Re, Im, |.|, 10 x 10 grid), with the authors' plotting script
staged_files.archive/fig2/tWSe2_3.15, archive/fig2/tM: archived SIESTA moire valence bands (Es-band.dat: blocks of (k distance in 1/A, energy in eV) per state along gamma-m-kappa-gamma, 61 points) and the SIESTA input
staged_files.archive/fig2/tWSe2_relaxation_*: relaxed tWSe2 structures (CONTCAR) and interpolated interlayer distance / in-plane displacement maps
staged_files.archive/fig3/tWSe2_3.15: surface Hartree potentials of 3.15 deg tWSe2 (top: pot_2d_top_sm.dat; bottom: pos_2d_bot_sm.dat, archived name), the line cut and the authors' scripts (the Fourier-amplitude files are sold by hartree_fourier)

dft_bands.returns: archived SIESTA moire valence bands along gamma-m-kappa-gamma

c3.returns: spin and C3z eigenvalue (complex, [Re, Im]) of the six highest moire valence states at the point, as determined by the authors

hartree_map.returns: tWSe2 top- and bottom-surface Hartree potential maps (n x n; a few MB of JSON)

hartree_linecut.returns: the archived line cut pot_diag-top.dat of that angle

hartree_fourier.returns: the archived Fourier-amplitude file pot_top_bot_G.dat of that angle (|g|/g1 <= 7)

structure.returns: relaxed tWSe2 structure (POSCAR) of that angle
